 MANDYA - 571 401

DISTRICT JUDGE AT MANDYA IN MA(LAC) NO.8/2012, DATED:
12.03.2014 AND JUDGMENT AND AWARD PASSED BY THE LEARNED CIVIL JUDGE (SR. DN.) & JMFC AT PANDAVAPURA IN LAC NO.90/2009 (OLD NO.381/2006), DATED 31.10.2011 BY ENHANCE THE COMPENSATION TO RS.2,25,000/- PER ACRE WITH ALL STATUTORY BENEFITS; b) PLEASED TO PASS ANY ORDER OR DIRECTIONS AS THIS HON'BLE COURT FEELS DEEMS FIT UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE, IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.
THIS MSA, COMING ON FOR FURTHER ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:

JUDGMENT Land bearing survey No.71/7 and 71/4 measuring 6 guntas and 11 guntas respectively situated at Kamanayakanahalli Village, Chinakurali Hobli, Pandavapura Taluk, Mandya District were proposed to be acquired for construction of Hemavathi Dam under the Notification issued under Section 4(1)
of the Land Acquisition Act which culminated in passing the award by the Land Acquisition Officer fixing the market value at Rs.47,800/- per acre.
2. The reference Court enhanced the market value of the subject land at Rs.1,53,400/- against which an appeal was filed before the learned District Court.
Learned District Court confirmed the award passed by the reference Court against which the present appeal is filed.

3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned HCGP for the State and perused the records.
4.
The subject land was acquired under the notification dated 11.02.2002.
The co-ordinate bench of this Court in MSA No.62/2014 has fixed the market value of the land acquired therein for the same purpose under the same notification at Rs.2,73,600/- per acre.

5. The Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of "Union of India (UOI) Vs. Bal Ram and Anr.,"
reported in (AIR 2004) SC 3981 has held that it would be unfair to discriminate between the land owners to pay more to some and less to others when the purpose of acquisition is same and lands are identical and similar, though lying in different villages.

sentences.text: 7. In view of the same, the market value of the subject value also requires to be fixed at Rs.2,73,600/-, so as to maintain parity.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) Appeal is allowed.

(ii) The impugned judgment and award dated 12.03.2014 passed by the III Additional District and Sessions Judge, Mandya (Sitting at Srirangapatna), in MA(LAC)
No.8/2012 and the impugned judgment and award dated 31.10.2011 passed by the Civil Judge, (Sr.Dn.) and JMFC at Pandavapura, in LAC No.90/2009 (old No.381/2006) are hereby modified.

entities.text: III Additional District and Sessions Judge, Mandya (Sitting at Srirangapatna
entities.label: COURT
